const now = new Date();
return [{json: {
  SPREADSHEET_ID: 'YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID',
  CHAT_ID: 'YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID',
  YANDEX_FOLDER_ID: 'YOUR_YANDEX_CLOUD_FOLDER_ID',
  YANDEX_API_KEY: 'YOUR_YANDEX_API_KEY',
  YANDEX_ENABLED: true,
  BRAND: 'Booster',
  DOMAIN: 'boosterpro.ru',
  RUN_MODE: String($input.first()?.json?.run_mode || 'FULL'),
  RUN_SOURCE: String($input.first()?.json?.run_source || 'manual-full'),
  RUN_ID: now.toISOString(),
  GPT_MODEL: 'openai/gpt-4.1-nano',
  GEMINI_MODEL: 'google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite',
  QWEN_MODEL: 'qwen/qwen3.6-27b',
  GPT_MAX_TOKENS: 160,
  GEMINI_MAX_TOKENS: 120,
  QWEN_MAX_TOKENS: 120,
  TEST_WEB_RESULTS: 3,
  MIN_COVERAGE: 0.80,
  DEV_QUERY_COUNT: 0,
  MAX_PRIMARY_COUNT: 20,
  SAVE_ONLY_FULL: false,
  YANDEX_RUB_PER_REQUEST: 5.08,
  DRIVE_FOLDER_NAME: 'AI_Visibility_Reports',
  SAVE_RESULTS: true,
  NOTE: 'FULL production: all ai_monitor=YES categories (fallback: all valid Master_Briefs rows). Hard safety cap 20 categories: if exceeded, workflow stops before paid AI requests. FULL State is isolated from DEV by FULL|provider|slug keys. Monthly schedule: day 10, 10:00 Europe/Moscow.'
}}];
return [{json:{read_previous_state:true}}];
return [{json:{run_mode:'FULL',run_source:'manual-full'}}];
return $input.all().filter(i => i.json?.kind === 'html').map(i => ({json:i.json,binary:i.binary}));

const cfg = $('Config — AI Visibility').first().json;
if (cfg.SAVE_RESULTS !== true) return [];

const rows = $('Collect AI Results').all().map(i => i.json || {});
const valid = rows.filter(r => !(r.data_error === true || String(r.data_error).toLowerCase() === 'true'));

return valid.map(r => ({json:{
  state_key: String(r.state_key || `${cfg.RUN_MODE}|${r.provider}|${r.slug}`),
  checked_at: r.checked_at || '',
  run_id: r.run_id || '',
  provider: r.provider || '',
  provider_label: r.provider_label || '',
  model: r.model || '',
  slug: r.slug || '',
  category: r.category || '',
  query: r.query || '',
  owner_url: r.owner_url || '',
  score_eligible: r.score_eligible || '',
  brand_control: r.brand_control || '',
  brand_mentioned: r.brand_mentioned === true || String(r.brand_mentioned).toLowerCase() === 'true',
  site_cited: r.site_cited === true || String(r.site_cited).toLowerCase() === 'true',
  models_mentioned: r.models_mentioned || '',
  source_urls: r.source_urls || '',
  answer_text: '',
  data_error: false,
  error: '',
  state_hash: r.state_hash || ''
}}));

const cfg = $('Config — AI Visibility').first().json;

const rows = $('Collect AI Results').all().map(i => i.json || {});

  owner_url: r.owner_url || '',
  score_eligible: r.score_eligible || '',
  brand_control: r.brand_control || '',
  brand_mentioned: r.brand_mentioned === true || String(r.brand_mentioned).toLowerCase() === 'true',
  site_cited: r.site_cited === true || String(r.site_cited).toLowerCase() === 'true',
  models_mentioned: r.models_mentioned || '',
